facts.text: The party owes Warwick metal brought back from the Dwarven mine to the north, in exchange for the loan of his mithril chain shirt; Sir Phidipaldi's lyre stays with Warwick to use nightly while they are gone.
facts.uncertain_reason: No quantity of metal was agreed.

facts.text: The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor, which he lent against the party's plate armor held as collateral.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated when the shirt must be returned.

facts.text: Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt over his leather armor, greatly improving his protection and halving damage from magic weapons and spells; it is on loan.

The Dwarven mine's entrance, at the foot of a hill beside a burnt log cabin, is sealed by a natural-looking cave-in, blocking the metal owed to Warwick; it can be dug through, and Dunk has partly broken into it.
Warwick believed seven dwarves worked the Dwarven mine, but it is caved in and Grimny is dead. Are any dwarves still inside or working it, and is there still metal to bring out?
